strings.ui:title: Good night clinic
strings.ui:description: A cozy fantasy clinic game: recycle the nightmares of small animals and send them back to the dreams you can face tomorrow.
strings.ui:hero:title: Good night clinic
strings.ui:actions:listen:label: Listen!
strings.ui:actions:soothe:label: Placation
strings.ui:actions:bottle:label: Close the bottle
strings.ui:actions:wake:label: Awaken
strings.ui:log:title: Dreams Fixed Tonight
strings.ui:clinic:startPrompt: When the moon rises to the window, the goodnight clinic opens.
strings.ui:clinic:readTrace: Read the dream marks and choose the most gentle and useful way to repair them.
strings.ui:clinic:miss: __ GC_placeholder_0 __ is not a good fit for __ GC_placeholder_1 __. The nightmare became a little smaller, but it still showed thorns.
strings.ui:clinic:logSuccess: __ GC_placeholder_0 __: Returned home with a small anchor for tomorrow.
strings.ui:clinic:logFail: __ GC_placeholder_0 __: A piece of a nightmare was temporarily placed in a bottle.
strings.ui:clinic:goodCloseTitle: The clinic held up into the early hours of the morning
strings.ui:clinic:goodClose: Repaired dreams do not change reality, but each patient takes away a small reason to be willing to face reality.
strings.ui:clinic:hardClose: Some dreams are too sharp tonight. The clinic will leave their names under a warm light and try again next time.
strings.ui:clinic:birds: The first birdsong was lit up outside the moon window.
strings.ui:clinic:moonWaits: The moon will pause a little longer in case anyone else needs a light.
strings.case:luma-moonbun:intro: Ruma always dreamed of a ladder made of moonlight. Every time he climbed close enough to reach the moon, the next step was broken.
strings.case:luma-moonbun:dreamGift: The clinic gave her a moonlight mailbox, and even if the answer was still far away, it would ring softly.
strings.case:luma-moonbun:morningAnchor: Tomorrow, Ruma would write the first real letter instead of waiting for the perfect one.
strings.case:luma-moonbun:clue1: Nightmares smell like warm milk and old stationery.
strings.case:luma-moonbun:clue2: Ruma said that the moon never wrote back.
strings.case:luma-moonbun:clue3: A small envelope pressed under her paw.
strings.case:mori-mossfox:intro: In Sen Sen's dream, there was a forest that he couldn't get out of. Before he could bid farewell to his friend, he always waved to him at the end of another path.
strings.case:mori-mossfox:dreamGift: The clinic opened a clearing for him, so that the late farewell could finally be said.
strings.case:mori-mossfox:morningAnchor: When he wakes up, Sen Sen will plant that seed next to the old road.
strings.case:mori-mossfox:clue1: The same leaf falls every twelve seconds.
strings.case:mori-mossfox:clue2: Sen Sen always apologizes before someone speaks.
strings.case:mori-mossfox:clue3: There is a seed that glows when dreams go backwards.
strings.case:nini-glass-hamster:intro: Nini was almost transparent tonight. There was a small black rain in his chest, and he kept tapping on the glass.
strings.case:nini-glass-hamster:dreamGift: The clinic put the black rain into a small bottle with a cork and slowly opened it when she was ready.
strings.case:nini-glass-hamster:morningAnchor: Tomorrow, Nini will say the name of a feeling first, not letting it fill the whole room.
strings.case:nini-glass-hamster:clue1: The quieter the room, the louder the rain.
strings.case:nini-glass-hamster:clue2: When Nini was about to cry, she always laughed first.
strings.case:nini-glass-hamster:clue3: Her shadow was hidden under the medical record holder.
strings.case:puff-cloudcat:intro: Puff wanted a pair of wings, but every time she flew, the lights of the city would get farther and farther away from her.
strings.case:puff-cloudcat:dreamGift: The clinic sent her on a safe rooftop flight, and every window lit up to welcome her back.
strings.case:puff-cloudcat:morningAnchor: Tomorrow, Puff will climb up to the roof to see a real sunrise.
strings.case:puff-cloudcat:clue1: The bell only rang when she bowed her head.
strings.case:puff-cloudcat:clue2: A string of paw prints appeared on the ceiling.
strings.case:puff-cloudcat:clue3: Puff whispered that the roof was almost the sky.
strings.case:fenn-lanterndeer:intro: As soon as Dream asked Finn to walk onto the stage, the small light on his corner would be extinguished.
strings.case:fenn-lanterndeer:dreamGift: The clinic lit up a stage for him to tremble, and the first tune counted.
strings.case:fenn-lanterndeer:morningAnchor: Tomorrow, Finn will sing a bad song first, because that's how the song starts.
strings.case:fenn-lanterndeer:clue1: There was a small, small applause in the lampshade.
strings.case:fenn-lanterndeer:clue2: Finn remembered the whole song but couldn't find the first tone.
strings.case:fenn-lanterndeer:clue3: Nightmares always brighten up before he's ready to start.
strings.case:no7-unknown-kit:intro: Number 7 does not have a nameplate. The dream door behind her was locked two times by herself.
strings.case:no7-unknown-kit:dreamGift: The clinic gave her a quiet room, and the word monster slowly turned back to fear.
strings.case:no7-unknown-kit:morningAnchor: Number seven left with a blank name tag, and she could decide what to call herself later.
strings.case:no7-unknown-kit:clue1: The nightmare repeats your last words in a smaller voice.
strings.case:no7-unknown-kit:clue2: When someone called her a monster, the number seven would immediately shrink.
strings.case:no7-unknown-kit:clue3: A blank collar is placed next to the dream gate.

sources.ui:title: 晚安诊所
sources.ui:description: 一款温馨轻怪谈梦境诊所游戏：回收小动物的噩梦，再把它们送回能面对明天的美梦里。
sources.ui:hero:title: 晚安诊所
sources.ui:actions:listen:label: 倾听
sources.ui:actions:soothe:label: 安抚
sources.ui:actions:bottle:label: 收瓶
sources.ui:actions:wake:label: 唤醒
sources.ui:log:title: 今晚修好的梦
sources.ui:clinic:startPrompt: 月亮升到窗边时，晚安诊所就开门。
sources.ui:clinic:readTrace: 阅读梦痕，然后选择最温柔也最有用的修复方式。
sources.ui:clinic:miss: {action}还不够适合{name}。噩梦变小了一点，但它仍然露着刺。
sources.ui:clinic:logSuccess: {name}：带着一个面向明天的小锚点回家了。
sources.ui:clinic:logFail: {name}：一枚噩梦碎片被暂时收进瓶里。
sources.ui:clinic:hardCloseTitle: 诊所还需要下一个夜晚
sources.ui:clinic:goodClose: 被修好的梦不会改变现实，但每位患者都带走了一个愿意面对现实的小理由。
sources.ui:clinic:hardClose: 今晚有些梦太尖了。诊所会把它们的名字留在暖灯下，等下一次再试。
sources.ui:clinic:birds: 月窗外，第一声鸟鸣已经亮起来。
sources.ui:clinic:moonWaits: 月亮会多停一会儿，以防还有谁需要灯。
sources.case:luma-moonbun:intro: 露玛总是梦见一架月光做成的梯子。每爬到快要够着月亮时，下一阶就碎掉了。
sources.case:luma-moonbun:dreamGift: 诊所送给她一只月光邮箱，就算答案还很远，也会轻轻响一声。
sources.case:luma-moonbun:morningAnchor: 明天，露玛会先写出第一封真正的信，而不是继续等一封完美的信。
sources.case:luma-moonbun:clue1: 噩梦闻起来像温热的牛奶和旧信纸。
sources.case:luma-moonbun:clue2: 露玛说月亮从来不回信。
sources.case:luma-moonbun:clue3: 一只小信封压在她的爪子下面。
sources.case:mori-mossfox:intro: 森森的梦里有一片走不出去的森林。没来得及告别的朋友，总在另一条小路尽头朝他挥手。
sources.case:mori-mossfox:dreamGift: 诊所为他开出一片空地，让那句迟到的告别终于可以被说完。
sources.case:mori-mossfox:morningAnchor: 醒来后，森森会把那粒种子种在旧路旁边。
sources.case:mori-mossfox:clue1: 同一片叶子每十二秒落下一次。
sources.case:mori-mossfox:clue2: 森森总是在别人开口前先道歉。
sources.case:mori-mossfox:clue3: 有一粒种子会在梦倒退时发光。
sources.case:nini-glass-hamster:intro: 妮妮今晚几乎是透明的。胸口里有一小团黑雨，一直敲着玻璃。
sources.case:nini-glass-hamster:dreamGift: 诊所把黑雨收进一只带软木塞的小瓶，等她准备好时再慢慢打开。
sources.case:nini-glass-hamster:morningAnchor: 明天，妮妮会先说出一个感受的名字，不让它填满整个房间。
sources.case:nini-glass-hamster:clue2: 妮妮快哭的时候，总会先笑出来。
sources.case:nini-glass-hamster:clue3: 她的影子躲在病历夹下面。
sources.case:puff-cloudcat:intro: 噗芙想要一对翅膀，可每次飞起来，城市的灯都会离她越来越远。
sources.case:puff-cloudcat:dreamGift: 诊所送她一场安全的屋顶飞行，每扇窗都亮着欢迎她回来。
sources.case:puff-cloudcat:morningAnchor: 明天，噗芙会爬上屋顶，看一次真正的日出。
sources.case:puff-cloudcat:clue2: 天花板上出现了一串爪印。
sources.case:puff-cloudcat:clue3: 噗芙小声说，屋顶几乎就是天空。
sources.case:fenn-lanterndeer:intro: 梦一要求芬恩走上舞台，他角上的小灯就会灭掉。
sources.case:fenn-lanterndeer:dreamGift: 诊所为他点亮一座允许颤抖的舞台，第一声跑调也算数。
sources.case:fenn-lanterndeer:morningAnchor: 明天，芬恩会先唱坏一次，因为歌就是这样开始的。
sources.case:fenn-lanterndeer:clue1: 灯罩里藏着很小很小的掌声。
sources.case:fenn-lanterndeer:clue2: 芬恩记得整首歌，却找不到第一个音。
sources.case:fenn-lanterndeer:clue3: 噩梦总在他准备开始前变得最亮。
sources.case:no7-unknown-kit:intro: 七号没有名字牌。她身后的梦门自己上了两道锁。
sources.case:no7-unknown-kit:dreamGift: 诊所给她一间安静房间，让怪物这个词慢慢变回害怕。
sources.case:no7-unknown-kit:morningAnchor: 七号带着空白名字牌离开，她可以晚一点再决定自己叫什么。
sources.case:no7-unknown-kit:clue1: 噩梦会用更小的声音重复你上一句话。
sources.case:no7-unknown-kit:clue2: 有人叫她怪物时，七号会立刻缩起来。
sources.case:no7-unknown-kit:clue3: 一枚空白项圈放在梦门旁边。
